Xocai Healthy Chocolate Martini
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Friday, September 16, 2011 - 6:27am

Ingredients




1 oz 	  Vodka or Gin
1 oz 	  Liquid Xocai Healthy Chocolate Activ drink
5 	  Ice
1  	  Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nugget, grated

Preparation

1 Shake Vodka and Xocai Activ in a martini shaker with ice and pour into a martini glass. 2 Garnish with grated Nugget. 3 Serves 1

About

Rich, Delicious Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate! What better way to toast Valentine’s Day, or any day for that matter.
